scope: One fixed 54-trial gyro-brake evaluation: 20 paired prior near-floor failure regressions, 16 prescribed standing releases including the eleventh prior failed start, and 18 fresh trials across nine directions. Four-case preflight and its audit pass before launch; .06 Nm s gain and .10 Nm per-wheel request cap stay frozen. Same four motors, 120 mm wheels, learned balance actor, hip timings, 24 s uncorrected native paths and final continuous 2 s standing gate. All failures retained; no automatic retries, new learning, sensor/terrain randomization or hardware qualification.
